summary: Frozen HEAD preserves the bounded read-only Cloudflare runtime contract with no database-state mutation, WAL attachment, upload, acknowledgement, deletion, or Worker deployment claim.

Valid requests are GET-only with redirects disabled, scoped non-secret errors, pagination/detail/error/retry UI, and existing Omi headers preserved. The WAL adapter is an unattached no-op seam. Post-freeze typecheck, unit, integration, and e2e records pass on the same HEAD without worktree mutation.
judgment_delta: The final judgment is pass because fresh post-freeze runner evidence binds to the frozen HEAD, source and tests cover the read-only contract, and the documents consistently exclude physical iPhone and deployed Worker claims.

Hermetic E2E is not device or deployed-runtime proof.
